detailed_description: PDF to Text is a free online tool that extracts text content from PDF documents. Simply upload your PDF file and get clean, readable text instantly. Supports multi-page PDFs with clear page markers. All processing happens in your browser - your files are never uploaded to any server.
usage_steps: Open the PDF to Text tool page
Drag and drop a PDF file or click to select
Wait for text extraction to complete
Copy the extracted text or download as TXT file
usage_examples: Convert PDF reports to editable text
